summary: The design phase owns the topic-specific Testing Strategy section, records project evidence, related ADR constraints, unit/integration/E2E strategy, and requires superseding ADRs before overriding related accepted ADRs.
title: Design owns the testing strategy

summary: The plan phase derives concrete validation items and testing-strategy trace metadata from the accepted strategy, maps every topic-generated requirement/scenario to validation coverage or justified exception, and rejects generic-only behavior-change gates.
title: Planning consumes strategy as validation obligations

summary: The workflow preserves existing test tools by default, requires user approval for major pivots, triggers ADR evaluation/generation for accepted major testing-toolchain changes, and blocks dependent implementation until the ADR path is explicit.
title: Existing-tool preservation with explicit ADR boundary

summary: Rejected because plan-only guidance is too late; design must decide strategy before implementation planning.
title: Keep testing guidance only in plans

summary: Rejected because existing projects may already have viable tools; major toolchain changes require user approval and ADR evaluation/generation.
title: Mandate Vitest and Playwright for all TypeScript projects

summary: Rejected because some changes only need one-time smoke, harness, or manual-assisted E2E validation before acceptance.
title: Require permanent recurring E2E CI for every change

summary: Design and plan validators produce machine-checkable evidence for strategy completeness, requirement/scenario coverage, traceability, E2E coverage, ADR triggers, and concrete plan validation gates before auditor review.
title: Deterministic gates produce evidence before auditor review

summary: Missing external evidence goes to researcher/archivist, judgment or consistency conflicts go to compass/oracle, and user-owned tool/ADR/risk decisions go to interview or user approval before validation and audit.
title: Uncertainty escalates to researcher, compass, or interview
